whatIs: Open Peeps is a library of hand-drawn illustrations of people by Pablo Stanley. It works like building pieces (arms, legs, expressions) that you combine to create characters and scenes, and there are also pre-assembled Peeps in PNG and SVG.
It's a good fit when you need illustrations with personality for a project and don't want to deal with licenses: they're free to use in both personal and commercial projects.
uses: Illustrating a product's landing page with a different character in each section.
Creating avatars or empty states in an app with pre-assembled Peeps.
Composing your own scenes in Figma, Sketch or XD by mixing the pieces.
caveats: To compose characters from scratch you need a compatible design tool, such as Figma, Sketch, XD or Blush.
The style is very recognizable, so other projects may look similar to yours.
The full downloads come from an external Gumroad link, not from the site itself.
pricingNote: Public domain under the CC0 license: free to use, including commercially and with no attribution.
idealFor: Landing pages and apps that want illustrations of people without license hassles.
